user.title: Add room

data_description.at_home_entity: When this is off/away, the room goes to frost protection.

data_description.room_sensor: Optional. Without it, the average of the heating devices' own readings is used (usually reads high next to a radiator).
data_description.manual_policy: What happens when someone changes temperature on a remote or thermostat.

data_description.boost_method: How to heat faster when the room is far below target. Using the AC keeps the radiators at the target temperature.
